research.facts:
LIV Golf Bankruptcy
**Primary Sources:**
- Front Office Sports: "LIV bankruptcy reveals PIF's $495M exit, player contract details" (https://frontofficesports.com/article/liv-bankruptcy-reveals-pifs-495m-exit-player-contract-details/)
- Gulf News: "LIV Golf bankruptcy: Rahm & DeChambeau among players owed millions" (https://gulfnews.com/sport/liv-golf-bankruptcy-rahm-dechambeau-among-players-owed-millions-1.500668129)
- Forbes Australia: "LIV Golf files for bankruptcy, owing its stars more than US$40 million" (https://www.forbes.com.au/news/sport/liv-golf-files-for-bankruptcy-owing-its-stars-more-than-40-million/)
- Golf Digest: "LIV Golf will know if it's ceasing operations by end of month" (https://www.golfdigest.com/story/liv-golf-will-know-if-its-ceasing-operations-by-end-of-month--ac)
- The Star Malaysia: "LIV Golf wins interim court approval to access $14 million in bankruptcy financing" (https://www.thestar.com.my/sport/golf/2026/09/11/liv-golf-wins-interim-court-approval-to-access-14-million-in-bankruptcy-financing)
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- LIV Golf filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy (New Jersey) — multiple sources
- $14M DIP financing approved by court — The Star
- Total owed to players: $40M+ — Forbes Australia
- Jon Rahm: approximately $7.5M owed — Gulf News/multiple sources
- Bryson DeChambeau: approximately $5.7M owed — Gulf News
- Targeting January 2027 emergence (LIV 2.0/BC Partners) — Golf Digest
- Court motion to reject executory contracts (DeChambeau, Johnson, Cameron Smith mentioned) — Golf Digest/Bloomberg
**Medium confidence:**
- Court actually rejected the contracts vs. filed a motion to reject — Bloomberg framing unclear
- Nov 24 hearing detail (from prior pipeline context)
